prompt:
Edit this Tzmil story illustration into a MUCH SIMPLER drawing by a beginner. Preserve the subject, soft lavender/cream/ochre palette and cozy storybook feeling, but radically reduce drawing skill and complexity across the WHOLE image.
Tzmil remains a pale gray human-faced young adult woman with short black hair, a fan of dark teal feathers with three simple ivory skulls, black dress with a few ivory rib marks, green/ochre serpent belt, bone motifs on limbs and ochre boots. She kneels next to a telescope looking through it, one hand on chest.
Draw her with slightly oversized head, lopsided eyes and smile, stiff bent arms, short simple mitten-like hands, awkward uneven knees and boots. Use only about 8 broad feather shapes, no feather veins. Skull ornaments are uneven round blobs with two dots. Ribcage motif only 4 crude curved lines. Serpent belt only two wobbly intertwined green and ochre bands, not ornamental jewelry. Telescope is a crooked brown tube and three stick legs, wrongish beginner perspective.
Background is EXTREMELY sparse: flat lavender sky, three crude cream cloud blobs, a few crooked star marks, ONE triangular purple volcano with small orange top and one wobbly lava line, two flat distant hill shapes. Foreground one broad purple slab without detailed rocks, foliage or scenic valley. Use large mostly flat patches of muted colors with light patchy crayon/gouache paper texture. Unsteady broken outlines, occasional gaps and slightly uneven fills. Genuine charming inexperienced hand drawn picture, intentionally crude proportions and staging. Keep shapes clear enough to recognize.
Do NOT merely add rough texture over polished anime anatomy. Remove refined face, graceful anatomical hands, professional shading, atmospheric landscape, many tiny plants, gradients, intricate costume rendering. Don't add extra characters, words, panels or borders. Single landscape 16:9 image.
status: Simplified first sample awaiting user feedback; not imported.
